summary: Setting up a Notion OAuth integration is straightforward and managed through the Notion Developer portal. The process involves creating a connection, configuring redirect URIs, and using the provided client credentials to implement the authorization flow.

approval.notes: The provided documentation does not specify a mandatory review or approval process for OAuth integrations.

steps.title: Access Developer Portal
steps.detail: Navigate to the Notion Developer portal to manage your connections.

steps.title: Create Integration
steps.detail: Create a new OAuth integration by entering the connection name, development workspace, and redirect URIs.

steps.title: Retrieve Credentials
steps.detail: Open the Configuration tab in your connection settings to find your OAuth client ID and OAuth client secret.

nuances: Installation scope cannot be changed after the integration is created.
If multiple members in a workspace want to use the same OAuth integration, each user must complete the authorization flow individually.
OAuth integrations can optionally offer a Notion template during the authorization flow.
agent_can_do: Draft the integration name and description.
Format redirect URIs for the configuration settings.
Store client ID and client secret in secure environment variables.
Implement the OAuth 2.0 authorization flow logic.
human_must_do: Log in to the Notion Developer portal.
Create the integration in the portal.
Copy the client ID and client secret from the Configuration tab.
Authorize the integration during the initial setup flow.
